name: Guam
facts: Unincorporated territory of the United States

flag.description: A dark blue field with a thin red border and, in the centre, the almond-shaped seal of Guam: a proa sailing in a bay beneath a coconut palm and a cliff, with the word GUAM in red letters.
flag.symbolism: The seal's almond shape recalls the sling stones of the ancient Chamorro people, and the cliff in the background is Two Lovers Point; the red border is said to represent the blood shed in the Second World War and under earlier Spanish rule.

hook: Guam frames its dark blue in a thin red border and spells out GUAM in red on an almond-shaped beach scene; the Northern Mariana Islands has a white star on a grey stone and no words.
trivia: The seal at the centre of the flag was designed by Helen Paul, the wife of a U.S. Navy officer stationed on the island.
The thin red border was a later addition to the original design.
